trust_decision.summary: Which certificate policy and identity checks authenticate the HTTPS proxy is decided when HTTPSConnection wraps the socket to the proxy; at the pin, the forwarding branch wraps it using the target's ssl_context, SNI, assert_hostname/fingerprint, client cert and cert_reqs/ca_certs, and the tunnel branch applies the target's cert_reqs/ca_certs/versions to (and mutates) the user's proxy_ssl_context.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'HTTPS proxy TLS configuration', and _connect_tls_proxy is the one method named and documented as the proxy TLS handshake using ProxyConfig.ssl_context.

fix_sites.entry_point: ProxyManager/proxy_from_url(...).request() with an https:// proxy and an http:// target, or use_forwarding_for_https=True with an https:// target (HTTPSConnection.connect forwarding branch); fix.diff:26-31
fix_sites.module_kind: core connection (target TLS handshake reused for the proxy handshake)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/urllib3/poolmanager.py:590-596 (ProxyConfig is built from the raw proxy_ssl_context argument; the fix adds a deprecated ssl_context fallback on the manager only and keeps it out of ProxyConfig, fix.diff:160-181, fix.diff:502-515)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The forwarding branch is the 'target' handshake (server_hostname, assert_hostname, cert_file are documented target options), and _connect_tls_proxy says it is only for tunnels (src/urllib3/connection.py:865), so a solver can argue that forwarding through an HTTPS proxy deliberately reuses the pool's TLS settings and that the ssl_context fallback is a compatibility default, not a security path.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Deprecated fallback: a forwarding HTTPS proxy given only ssl_context must still use it for the proxy handshake (with FutureWarning); an HTTPS proxy to an HTTP target with ssl_context keeps working; a tunnel without proxy_ssl_context still inherits the pool's cert_reqs/ca_certs; the target TLS in tunnel mode still uses target settings. Blanket-ignoring pool TLS settings for the proxy breaks all of these.

O6_input_shapes: forwarding (http target, or https target with use_forwarding_for_https) vs. CONNECT tunnel (fix.diff:27-31)
target cert_reqs=CERT_NONE + ca_certs altering/mutating the proxy context's verify_mode and cert store (fix.diff:421-446)
proxy_config None on an HTTPS proxy pool (fix.diff:193-198)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An HTTP/2 connection that accepts a forwarding HTTPS proxy and wraps the proxy socket with its own target TLS kwargs in its own connect().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: HTTP2Connection subclasses HTTPSConnection and only refuses proxies defensively; adding proxy support there is plausible future work, and it would sit in a separate package.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A SOCKS-over-TLS pool variant whose proxy handshake reuses the target pool's cert_reqs/ca_certs.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: contrib/socks already ships a separate HTTPS pool class for proxied connections; a TLS-to-proxy option would plausibly reuse the pool's TLS kwargs.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A deprecated proxy set_cert-style setter that writes proxy identity settings onto the shared target fields.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: set_cert already exists as a deprecated mutator for these exact fields, so a proxy twin follows the house style.
